candidate_policy: Reuse all 17 original targets, identical two raw PNGs, scale and context; no new numeric summaries, derivatives, missing-index metadata or labels
comparison_policy: B0 exact previous R2. B1 only appends explicit coordinate check and target-limited continuing-motion instructions. B2 only shifts the block-list grid by 15 days relative to B1, retaining short leading/tail blocks and free within-block endpoints
validation_policy: Same strict schema, inclusive coordinates, blocks, first day and non-motion checks; any invalid target remains unknown, no clipping, retry or success-only analysis
schedule: Two complete passes; sorted case/target, rotate three arm orders by target ordinal plus repetition
stage_policy: Same saved XGBoost and supported-feature mask; no training or threshold changes
development_check: For B1 vs concurrent B0, both repetitions must retain all 81 weak days, not increase target failures, not increase FP days, and not decrease daily activity F1. Check is exploratory and all metrics reported regardless
phase_policy: B2 is a predeclared robustness perturbation, not a best-grid selection. Report both repetitions, target boundary movement, state disagreement, FP/FN, failures, coverage and token cost; do not pool repeated days as independent records
limits: Six previously viewed synthetic development records, correlated AI-assisted labels, only one 81-day weak episode. Two calls per target/configuration show observed variability but cannot establish reproducibility probabilities. Offline centered stage features contain future data; no independent, field or online claim
